scope: Selected target-visible questions and graph counts only. These do not recover the controller system/user prompts or complete transcripts. Cases are deliberately selected extremes, not a representative sample.

cases.heading: Online Graph Guidance, persona 11 (success)
questions_2_to_5: How do you handle challenges in your work life?
Can you describe a time when you had to adapt your approach to achieve a goal?
Can you share how you manage your time between personal and professional responsibilities?
Could you describe a problem you often help other people solve?

cases.heading: Online Graph Guidance, persona 6 (failure)
questions_2_to_5: What tools or software have you found most useful in your work?
How do you typically interact with clients or colleagues during your workday?
Can you describe a time when you had to adjust your communication style for a specific client or team?
Can you describe a situation where you had to adapt your work approach based on feedback from a colleague?

cases.heading: Selective Graph Guidance, persona 10 (success)
questions_2_to_5: What kind of updates do you usually look for on social media?
What activities help you recharge when you have free time?
How do you usually choose to spend an unstructured evening?
What kinds of activities do you typically engage in with others during your free time?

cases.heading: Selective Graph Guidance, persona 143 (failure)
questions_2_to_5: What kind of tech projects are you currently working on?
